name: Black Flame
primary:
Unquenchable black flames. The creature you look at within 32 blocks bursts into black fire that water can't put out, for 10 s:
• Constant burning
• Damage 0.75 ❤ death every second
• If the victim dies, the flames jump to the nearest foe within 4 blocks
self_description: A ring of black flames of radius 3 surrounds you for 5 s: foes who touch it burn and take 0.75 ❤ death once a second.
